concepts.title: Poshan Sakhi: SHG-led Nutrition-Sensitive Livelihoods, Phase II
concepts.theme: Integrated women's livelihoods and household nutrition

geography.block: To be selected with the applicant, prioritising blocks with existing EcoKheti SHG presence
geography.coverage: Selected villages in 2–3 blocks, building outward from existing SHG clusters

concepts.target: Tribal women SHG members and their households, roughly 1,500–2,500 women, including new SHGs and graduates of the earlier programme
concepts.core_problem: Income gains alone do not reliably translate into better diets. Tribal households can remain food- and nutrient-insecure when livelihood activities are not linked to household food production, nutrition knowledge and public nutrition services. The size of this gap in Khunti will be established by research.
concepts.why_fit_org: Scales EcoKheti's strongest demonstrated model: the SRLM-funded SHG livelihoods and nutrition programme in Khunti and Gumla, with 1,200 women, income increase of at least 45%, and improved dietary diversity in 60% of households. It fits the organisation's values of women's agency and convergence with public systems. A proven government partnership makes it credible for SRLM/JSLPS and CSR co-funding.
concepts.rough_budget_band: Approximately Rs. 1.5–2.5 Crore over 3 years (planning estimate from sector experience, to be confirmed by the applicant and costing)

concepts.title: Women-Led Nutri-Cereal and Forest-Produce Value Chain through FPO Strengthening
concepts.theme: Women's collective enterprise, FPO market linkage and nutrition

geography.block: To be selected with the applicant based on existing FPO and SHG presence
geography.coverage: Catchment of 2–3 women-majority FPOs (new or existing)

concepts.target: Women smallholders and SHG members federated into FPOs, roughly 1,000–1,500 members
concepts.core_problem: Women producers in tribal areas often sell small, unaggregated volumes at low prices. They also lack processing, grading and market access. Traditional nutritious crops and minor forest produce are under-valued both in markets and in household diets. Research will confirm which specific crops and produce suit the chosen blocks.
concepts.why_fit_org: Builds on the FPO strengthening project in Jharkhand, where 3 FPOs with 900 members roughly doubled their aggregated sales. It also draws on the SHG base and nutrition experience in Gumla. The model combines market income with household consumption of nutritious produce, which suits CSR funders focused on enterprise and government FPO schemes.
concepts.rough_budget_band: Approximately Rs. 2–3.5 Crore over 3–4 years, excluding any FPO equity or working-capital leverage from public schemes (planning estimate, to be confirmed)

concepts.title: Climate-Resilient Farming for Women Farmers and Household Food Security
concepts.theme: Climate-resilient livelihoods and nutrition security for women farmers

geography.block: One or two blocks per district, to be selected with the applicant
geography.coverage: Rainfed farming villages within existing SHG coverage

concepts.target: Women small and marginal farmers from SHG households, roughly 1,000–1,500 farmers
concepts.core_problem: Rainfed tribal farming households face climate variability that threatens both income and year-round food availability. Women farmers are often excluded from extension services, inputs and adaptive technologies. Local climate risk and farming patterns will be established by research.
concepts.why_fit_org: Transfers the Chhattisgarh climate-resilient agriculture model, where 70% of 800 farmers adopted climate-adaptive practices, into EcoKheti's Jharkhand SHG geography. It combines 5 years of climate-livelihoods experience with the women's SHG and nutrition base. The concept suits climate-focused CSR mandates and convergence with state agriculture and watershed programmes.
concepts.rough_budget_band: Approximately Rs. 1.5–2.5 Crore over 3 years (planning estimate, to be confirmed)

concepts.title: First 1,000 Days: SHG-Anganwadi Convergence for Maternal and Child Nutrition
concepts.theme: Maternal and child nutrition through community and public-system convergence

geography.block: One or two blocks, to be selected with the applicant
geography.coverage: Villages served by a defined set of Anganwadi centres overlapping EcoKheti SHG coverage

concepts.target: Pregnant and lactating women and caregivers of children under two in SHG households and the wider community, roughly 1,500–3,000 mothers and caregivers over the project period
concepts.core_problem: Uptake of public maternal and child nutrition services can be low, and feeding and care practices during the first 1,000 days may not match recommended norms. Community structures such as SHGs are under-used for behaviour change and service demand. Local nutrition status and service gaps will be quantified by research.
concepts.why_fit_org: Draws on 6 years of maternal and child nutrition programming and on the dietary-diversity results from the Khunti and Gumla SHG programme. It puts the organisation's value of convergence with public systems (ICDS/Anganwadi, health system, JSLPS) at the centre. The concept is attractive to government nutrition programmes and to CSR health and nutrition mandates.
concepts.rough_scale: 1,500–3,000 mothers and caregivers; roughly 50–100 SHGs and associated Anganwadi centres
concepts.rough_budget_band: Approximately Rs. 1–2 Crore over 3 years (planning estimate, to be confirmed)

note: These four concepts are starting points built from EcoKheti's demonstrated SHG, nutrition, FPO and climate-livelihoods work and its preference for Khunti and Gumla. Please pick one, combine elements, or adjust geography and scale. Block selection is left open so you can anchor it in villages where you already work. Scales, durations and budget bands are rough planning estimates, not statistics. They are sized relative to the organisation's current revenue and past project scale. All problem figures, demographic data and costs will be established by grounded research and by your own confirmation before the proposal is drafted.
